name: Translate texts with specific tone and style instructions
description: Users requested translations of specific texts between various languages, often with explicit instructions to adjust tone, style, register, or format, or to combine translation with paraphrasing, summarizing, or grammatical analysis. The source content varied widely across business documents, technical descriptions, personal messages, and literary excerpts, and most requests required the output to sound natural or faithful to a specific persona rather than being a literal word-for-word conversion.
